design.explanationStage: Selected candidates plus one rejected comparator; full team and current baseline retained; fixed candidate order and chosen form.
design.reviewMethod: Same-agent manual review of all public paragraphs/cards against frozen records. Hash labels suppressed arm names during reading, but not independently blind; some earlier progress summaries revealed arm identity. Conservative counting excludes ambiguous references.
design.limitations: Six cases, four new recombined rosters with familiar set components; same-agent manual review, not independent or population-representative.

rubric.factualIssues: Only explicit contradictions against frozen request facts; count each response once regardless of issue count.
rubric.strategicConcerns: Separately recorded debatable advice or missing useful comparison, not treated as mechanically proven factual errors.
rubric.utilityScore: 0 unusable; 1 generic/action unclear; 2 concrete role and true gain/cost; 3 additionally meaningfully uses team roles/field/alternatives. Subjective same-agent review, not independent.
